input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit right binding us, and it meets the preferred position in full: frequency capped at once per twelve months (22.1), thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, conducted by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2), and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information. Section 23 contains no operative Vendor audit right, and no remote-monitoring or unannounced-inspection language appears elsewhere. Section 22.3 (findings as our Confidential Information, copy of the final report, shortfall payment resolving the issue) is additional protection in our favour. No redline required.
